content.title: SXSW 2026 will be 'reimagined,' only one weekend
content.text: South by Southwest (SXSW) will shorten its schedule for 2026, running for just seven days from March 12-18, organizers announced Monday.The condensed format marks a notable shift for the influential tech, film, television and music festival, which will occupy only one weekend instead of its traditional multi-weekend schedule.The festival is also restructuring its badge system while offering presale discounts. SXSW is eliminating the secondary access model that previously allowed badge holders to attend events outside their primary track."For 2026, we're lowering presale badge prices to help ensure that SXSW is for everyone," organizers said in a statement. "We'll also be streamlining access to improve the experience."2026 badges (PHOTO: SXSW)PREVIOUS COVERAGE | Austin's $1.2 billion remodel leaves the future of SXSW's location in questionAustin police seek man wanted on robbery, other warrants since July 2025PRESALE PRICES:Platinum Badge: $1,165.00Interactive Badge: $785.00Film & TV Badge: $700.00Music Badge: $475.00SXSW EDU Badge: $495.00While Interactive, Film & TV, and Music registrants will have access to programming specific to their badge type plus keynotes and expos, only Platinum Badge holders will have entry to all festival offerings. Organizers noted quantities for Platinum presale badges are limited.A spokesperson provided the following statement:“We are really excited about the plans for SXSW 2026. With the Austin Convention Center closing down for three years, we believe it’s a great opportunity to put new ideas into action.A shorter SX gives attendees more of a chance to be here for the entire run. With the Conference, Film & TV Festival, and Music Festival all taking place concurrently over seven days, everyone will have the chance to experience the whole of SXSW.This gives music fans an opportunity to enjoy seven nights of showcases instead of the six we’ve had for several years. It also allows us to continue the work the Music Festival programmers have done over the last decade in paring down the numbers of showcasing artists while spreading the shows out over a greater part of the event. This creates a more curated experience for attendees and artists while retaining the discovery that the music festival is known for.We also know that post-pandemic attendees want more personalized experiences, and we’re excited to explore new ways to bring people together.”The changes come as the Austin Convention Center undergoes a complete redesign expected to last until 2029. SXSW plans to create industry-specific hubs throughout Austin to accommodate attendees during the renovation.Presale badges for the 2026 festival are now available at discounted rates until March 31, 2025. Early purchasers will secure the lowest available rates and first access to hotel bookings, according to organizers.
